rulesHashContract.scope: identity, current rules/paytable, frontend decisions and captured config oracle

boardModel.wireFlattening: reel-major: reel0 rows0..2, reel1 rows0..2, reel2 rows0..2

winModelDetails.matchRequirement: three matching symbols on a payline after WILD substitution

paytable.unit: multiplied by bs and bl per winning line before rpx

frontendAnimationOnly.codeUse: GameConfigData.randomReel builds client-side rolling filler strips

symbolWeights.implementationRule: Do not copy the animation filler values into Java generation probabilities and do not infer probabilities from sample frequencies.
symbolWeights.evidence: frontend SymbolWeightsList/randomReel; no server reel strips or probability configuration were captured

specialModes.entry: gm=1 in the paid Spin response
specialModes.ruleTrigger: same symbol and/or WILD stacked on two reels without a fixed-payline win
specialModes.capturedTriggerRefinement: in reel-major row order, each held reel is WILD* followed by repetitions of one compatible symbol; suffix-WILD stacks did not trigger
specialModes.effect: the two qualifying reels stay fixed and the remaining rdri reel performs exactly one free respin
specialModes.stepBoundary: S01 paid board = rskl with reel rdri replaced by rdskl; S02 free final board = rskl
specialModes.retrigger: NOT_SUPPORTED; the response and frontend contain exactly one embedded respin transition and then terminate
evidence: 50 two-step entries in captures/50-Lucky-Cat-II/spin-index.jsonl with zero adjacency mismatch

specialModes.entry: rpx>1 in the paid Spin response or embedded Lucky Respin final result
specialModes.trigger: all 3x3 positions contain one common non-WILD symbol and/or WILD
specialModes.effect: multiply every winning-line payout and total award by rpx
specialModes.deliveryBoundary: board result and wheel multiplier are delivered in one response; wheel animation is not another Spin or paid Round
specialModes.probabilityDistribution: UNKNOWN; rule text explicitly says wheel graphic distribution is not actual probability
evidence: 48 complete rpx>1 Rounds with zero trigger mismatch

unconfirmedModes.reason: generic fbt/fcg framework fields exist, but current rules and all current-game samples only establish one embedded Lucky Respin
authenticated runtime tree, bundle tokens and rules contain no purchase entry

unsupportedPortalAlias.behavior: retain pt; do not alias to es

requestOrder: PING only when session ping.enable is truthy

codecContract.requestBody: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; UTF-8 percent encoding; spaces encoded as +
codecContract.successRule: HTTP 2xx and string/number code equal to 200; frontend resolves data or {}
errorRules: business code other than 200 rejects with the parsed wrapper
non-2xx rejects; non-JSON/no-code response becomes {code: HTTP<status>, info: ''}
Spin failure restores displayed balance, clears auto-play and unlocks play controls
Ping HTTP0 retries; other Ping errors are shown
codecContract.typeRule: preserve endpoint-specific number/string types; History list monetary fields are strings while Spin fields are numbers

roundModel.paidStart: one authenticated POST /api/v1/golden-cat/spin with bl and bs
roundModel.roundIdRule: one spin-index.jsonl line per real paid start; provider tis/bid are optional on direct Spin responses
roundModel.deliveryModel: one HTTP response delivers the entire Round
stepRules: gm=0: one paid S01 step and terminal
gm=1: paid S01 plus embedded free S02 Lucky Respin final board under the same roundId
rpx>1 adds an in-delivery wheel award phase but not another spin-index step
no free/respin/wheel phase may be counted as another paid Round
roundModel.terminalCondition: after S01 for gm=0; after exactly one embedded S02 for gm=1; wheel presentation consumes the same response and then terminates

runtimeIndependentLoss.contract: gm=0, rpx=1, wa=0, wmkl={} is a terminal independent paid LOSS
runtimeIndependentLoss.implementationConstraint: Demo never generates at request time. Independent LOSS members are produced only by the formal GameRuleCore in the Redis Loader and claimed from BetLog 0.

redisContract.integerMultiplier: wa/(bs*bl) exact integer; 0 = ordinary or lucky miss
redisContract.runtimeSourceRule: Demo claims one complete member per paid Spin from Redis db 15. Empty pool fails. Fixtures are never a runtime source.
redisContract.implementationRule: Loader writes GameRuleCore complete rounds; Controller only LINDEX/restores the same member.
